description: Subscribe a public HTTPS endpoint to registration.created, sale.completed and/or refund.completed for an event you host. Signing secret is returned ONCE. Use a unique request_id; retries with the same ID do not create another endpoint or reveal the secret again. Deliveries contain resource IDs and amounts; read guest/sale APIs for contacts and answers. Requires a write key. Max five active endpoints per event.
name: create_event_webhook
title: Create Event Webhook
